newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar's minister of power said Qatar was to invest $18 billion to develop the oil and gas sectors.
- Syrian official sources said the country's central region gas project would begin producing three million cubic metres of gas per day by the end of 1997.
- Bahrain's electricity minister said Bahrain planned to construct a power station with a daily capacity 260 megawatts and 30 million gallons of desalinated water at a cost of $375 million.
